semiconductor_relevance: Medium — Nihon University, Ogawa Laboratory is primarily an educational and research institution focused on material development for semiconductor devices.
summary: Nihon University, Ogawa Laboratory conducts advanced research on materials for next-generation semiconductor devices, emphasizing material synthesis and evaluation. Their work includes innovative techniques such as photoelectron-controlled plasma CVD for carbon materials and studying Si thermal oxidation processes using synchrotron radiation.
capabilities: Photoelectron-controlled plasma CVD for carbon material synthesis
Research on Si thermal oxidation mechanisms using synchrotron radiation
Development of deposited films for semiconductor applications
